phrases.latin: Ubīque muscus est, in saxīs, in truncīs, in mūrīs; ubīque filicēs
phrases.english: Moss everywhere, on the rocks, on the trunks, on the walls; ferns everywhere
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
